opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction search by city, keyword and sort
opportunities.description: Search Trip.com's Attractions & Tickets for a destination city and keyword, sort the results (Top Rated or Lowest Price), and open a result.
steps: Open trip.com and click the Attractions & Tickets tab.
Click the Destination (City or Region) field and type the city, then pick the matching city suggestion.
Click the Keywords field and type the keyword (for example 'amusement park').
Click the search icon to run the search.
Click the sort tab for the desired order (Top Rated or Lowest Price).
Click the attraction title to open its detail page.
parameters: sort order (Top Rated or Lowest Price)

instances.values: Destination 'Hong Kong' (suggestion picked), keyword 'Park', sort 'Top Rated', opened 'Shanghai Wild Animal Park', then clicked 'Nearby' tab on the detail page.
Destination 'seoul' (suggestion 'Seoul, South Korea'), keyword 'amusement park', sort 'Lowest Price', opened 'Cerdon caves - Prehistoric Amusement Park'.

opportunities.name: KOA campground search by destination, filters and dates
opportunities.description: Search KOA's campground finder for a destination, optionally set an accommodation filter, choose check-in and check-out dates, and run Find a KOA.
steps: Open koa.com and, if needed, click Filters to expand advanced options.
Tick the ways-to-stay checkbox (e.g. RV Site).
Click the 'Where do you want to go?' field, type the destination, and pick a suggestion.
Click the Check In calendar, navigate months with Next, and click the arrival day.
Click the Check Out calendar and click the departure day.

instances.values: Filters opened, 'RV Site' checked, destination 'California' typed, no dates set, FIND A KOA clicked.

Destination 'Lansing' (suggestion 'East Lansing / Lansing, MI' area chosen), check-in 06/07/2023, check-out 06/12/2023, FIND A KOA clicked. Trip.com and KOA rewards actions were interleaved between the two segments.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways baggage allowance lookup by cabin class
opportunities.description: Open the Baggage allowance page on qatarairways.com and read the allowance table for a chosen cabin class.
steps: Open qatarairways.com and click Experience in the top menu.
Click the Baggage allowance link under 'Before you fly'.
Click the cabin tab for the desired class (Economy, Business or First).
Read the allowance table for the chosen cabin.
parameters: cabin class (Economy Class, Business Class, First Class)
